world.title: Nvidia halts server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia after tighter US export controls
world.summary: Nvidia has told partners such as Dell and Supermicro to stop shipping servers to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. Following new US export controls targeting Chinese cloud access, dealers are already seeking buyers for thousands of B300 chips, while one cloud executive describes "chaos", Loans and major deals are now on the line for Southeast Asia's data centers.

world.title: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites for orbital AI data centers by 2040
world.summary: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million Starmind satellites to process AI data as orbital data centers. SpaceX is targeting its first launches in 2027, and the full constellation is set to be operating by 2040. Google and Blue Origin are also working on AI infrastructure in space, but Boston Consulting Group estimates costs will stay well above ground-based data centers for now.

world.title: OpenAI and Cisco Releases Shirudo: An Open-Source Linux Runtime Allowing Agents to Defend Systems Without Downtime
world.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a pre-release, BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux. AI agents write signed "shields" that block exploit paths on running systems while teams test and roll out real patches.
